title: Svalbard Global Seed Vault Top View.jpg
author: Michael Major for Crop Trust
description: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault was inaugurated in February 2008 as a secure backup facility for the world's crop diversity on the Svalbard archipelago of Norway. As of February 2025 it has received seed samples from 123 genebanks in 85 countries around the world. Photo: Michael Major for Crop Trust
